name: gworkspace-cli
title: 通过“gw” CLI 与 Google Workspace（云端硬盘、文档、表格）交互
description: Interact with Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets) via the `gw` CLI. Use when an agent needs to browse, read, create, search, or manage files in Google Drive, read or write Google Docs, or read/write Google Sheets — all from the terminal. Works with both My Drive and Shared Drives.
